name: Grand Hotel Minerva Florence
positioning: Grand Hotel Minerva, a historic palazzo hotel on Piazza Santa Maria Novella shaped by architect Carlo Scarpa, with art throughout and a rooftop pool over Florence
best_for: Travelers who want to walk everywhere in Florence's historic center
Fans of art and mid-century Italian design

facts.text: The hotel is located directly in the pedestrianized Piazza Santa Maria Novella in Florence's historic center.
The hotel is 350 metres from Santa Maria Novella station and a 6-minute walk from the Duomo.
The building began as housing for the monks of Santa Maria Novella over seven hundred years ago.
The palazzo was converted into an inn for travelers in 1848.
Unique Rooms such as Suite 103 feature preserved 18th-century frescoes and high ceilings.
Sculptures by Emilio Greco are in the main lobby and common areas.
Futurist and metaphysical sketches by Carlo Carra are in select suites.
Carlo Scarpa's ground-floor breakfast room, with his original chairs, has been left virtually untouched.
The marble bathrooms are supplied with products by local perfumer Lorenzo Villoresi.
For families, the hotel provides children's kits, welcome gifts and a Kids' Concierge.
La Buona Novella, the hotel's street-level restaurant with a summer terrace on the piazza, serves elevated versions of regional classics.

highlights.text: A bar with a heated swimming pool sits on the very top of the palazzo, with a 360-degree view of the city and its monuments.
A window frame Carlo Scarpa designed for the hotel is identical to the frames he created for the Uffizi Gallery.
When Carlo Scarpa transformed the hotel, he left a few rooms unaltered, with frescoes and original hand-painted ancient wooden beams that still exist today.
Work by Fluxus artist Giuseppe Chiari covers all the walls of the breakfast room.
Most of the hotel's windows frame a view of Florence, the Duomo or the Cloisters of Santa Maria Novella.

considerations.text: The heated rooftop pool is seasonal, not open year-round.
The hotel sits in a car-free pedestrian zone; valet parking is available.
In the evening the rooftop pool bar also welcomes non-hotel guests.
